title: CARIAD: GIS Invoice erWIN
description:
This is a short 2-month project

Complete, verifiable initial migration of all historical invoice data and reliable continuous 
ingestion of new invoices, both with zero document loss. 
• Legally compliant, revision-safe (revisionssicher / WORM) archiving in accordance with GoBD, 
DSGVO and the 15-year KSU retention requirement. 
• Cross-brand findability and retrieval of invoices via metadata and full-text search. 
• Provision of invoices to internal customer service, auditors and brands via a simple, accesscontrolled web application. 
• A turnkey, low-effort operating model so that a single business operator can run the service 
without deep technical skills. 
• A scalable architecture that absorbs continuous growth of the archive over the full retention 
period without architectural change or loss of performance. 
• Successful completion of the mandatory Volkswagen Group IT-Security process, FOSS 
process, and an external Penetration Test.
